items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: One named Ed because I can remember my mother used to call Uncle Ed.

ctx.x: Yeah and my great grandfather's name was Tom. I can remember now. His name was Tom Lewis and he had a son named Robin Lewis, that was my mother's father. Grandpa Tom had several boys. I don't know how many girls he had but one of the boys' name was Robin and that was my mother's father.
One named Ed because I can remember my mother used to call Uncle Ed.
Yes. So my grandfather's son ... (several of them) He was born in slavery, I remember that, but he was never a slave. He wasn't a slave. ... they
